title: test(dogfood): pin access-security checklist clauses at the api oracle's layer, slice 1
body:

_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8YSjPf3hTSLEBa52VUBikb4)_

Refs #26571 (slice 1 of about 4, items: access-security.rls-both-sides, access-security.write-path-guards, access-security.crud-permission-matrix, access-security.owd-sharing-matrix, access-security.fls-mask-and-strip)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：给 access-security 区前 5 个清单条目补上 dogfood 断言（进程内 HTTP，正是这些条款的 oracle 层），共钉住 19 条此前只靠现场手跑的条款；5 个条目的 `automated.ref` 改写成逐条款对应、`revision` 加一、`history` 记本卡。
- 为什么改：18.2.0 Tier 1 记录 #26468 里这 5 条全是 PARTIAL——旧断言只看状态码、不复读行，或只覆盖部分对象/人设；每次发版都要重新手跑。钉住后成为可重复跑的常备证明。
- 风险与回滚：只加测试和改清单文字，不动任何产品代码；新增断言全部按现行行为写成并跑绿。dogfood 仍在原有位置运行，没有新 CI 通道。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：① `showcase-crud-persona-matrix.dogfood.test.ts` 新增的 delegate × sys_* 16 格用例（含 sys_user 的 405）；② `showcase-readonly-when-parent.dogfood.test.ts` 的 updateMany 逐行用例；③ `access-security.json` 里 crud-permission-matrix 的新 `automated.ref`。
- 两分钟验证：`cd packages/qa/dogfood && pnpm exec vitest run test/showcase-crud-persona-matrix.dogfood.test.ts`（需先按 dogfood 惯例 build 依赖闭包），预期 `Tests 49 passed`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Pins at the layer each clause's oracle names (`api`: the in-process HTTP stack of `@objectstack/verify`), in `packages/qa/dogfood/**` only. No product code changes. Every new assertion was written against today's behaviour and is green.

| item | clauses newly pinned | where |
|---|---|---|
| rls-both-sides | acceptance[2], acceptance[3], negative[0] | `showcase-private-owd`: the admin re-reads the foreign note after the refused PATCH (whole record equal), and the admin's filtered list carries every note the file created |
| write-path-guards | acceptance[0], [4], [5], [6], negative[0] | `showcase-static-readonly`: INSERT strip advertised in body `droppedFields` and the `X-ObjectStack-Dropped-Fields` header. `owner-anchor-and-bulk-writes`: member REST `createMany` stamps the caller on all three rows; the admin's forge-insert and disown pass. `showcase-readonly-when-parent`: the paid line's `product` is held; a mixed `updateMany` reports `results[i].droppedFields` (`readonly_when`) on the locked row only, and the open row lands; `updateMany` with `continueOnError: true` fails the row below `min: 0` alone (`VALIDATION_FAILED`, unchanged) and applies both neighbours, with the default stop shape (tail `NOT_ATTEMPTED`) pinned beside it |
| crud-permission-matrix | acceptance[0], [1], [3], [6], negative[0] | `showcase-crud-persona-matrix`: the auditor's viewAllRecords over a foreign inquiry, invoice and line (by id and filtered list) against a contributor who holds read without the bit; the first denied cell of every set re-run as the admin answers 2xx; and the 16 `showcase_field_ops_delegate` × `sys_*` cells driven by a member holding exactly that set, with `sys_user` create and delete scored 405 `OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED` for the delegate and the admin |
| owd-sharing-matrix | acceptance[0], [1], [4], [5] | `showcase-private-owd` / `showcase-public-read-owd`: non-2xx by-id read, PATCH at least 400, admin re-read unchanged. New `showcase-invoice-line-contributor-pair` (shared-showcase project): two stock `showcase_contributor` members C1/C2 and a stock `showcase_auditor`; C2's filtered list excludes C1's line while C1's identical list carries it, C2's by-id read and PATCH are refused with the row unchanged, C1 reads and edits it, the auditor lists and reads it |
| fls-mask-and-strip | acceptance[0], [2] | `showcase-permission-zoo`: the contributor's name edit re-reads changed; the admin's budget write on a seeded project lands and re-reads changed (raised, then put back) |

Ledger: each of the five items gets a rewritten `automated.ref` that maps clauses to cases, `revision` +1, and a `history` row citing #26571. The owd-sharing-matrix ref also names two existing `showcase-crud-persona-matrix` cases that already pinned its acceptance[2] (modifyAllRecords) and acceptance[3] (`showcase_contributor` / `showcase_member_default` × `showcase_project` edit cells), which revision 5 recorded as unpinned.

`vitest.config.ts`: the new file joins `SHARED_SHOWCASE`. It meets that list's three eligibility rules: plain showcase boot, only `sys_user_permission_set` rows for its own sign-ups, and every list filtered to its own row.

Clauses left as they are, each with its reason in the item's `automated.ref`:

- rls-both-sides acceptance[5], negative[1], negative[2]: procedural (a reading of the verify report, run-record rules), and the D11 spot-check needs the private write-up.
- crud-permission-matrix acceptance[5]: `blocked(fixture)` per knownGaps[2] (the guest anchor intake is not observable on a member persona).
- owd-sharing-matrix acceptance[6]: procedural (run-record completeness).
- fls-mask-and-strip acceptance[3] and the UI half of acceptance[4]: `dom` / browser oracle. The dogfood suite drives no browser and the ruling adds no CI lane, so they stay a run's browser leg.

## Tests

Head `fd634911`, the eight touched files, under `os-verify-lock`: `Test Files 8 passed (8)`, `Tests 103 passed (103)` (`VERDICT command-exit 0`). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck`: exit 0. The full dogfood battery is CI's (no `!` in the title, no narrowing arm).

## Acceptance notes

- crud-permission-matrix `acceptance[6].verify` and `steps[6]` still describe the 16 delegate cells as hand-driven, and the same file's header comment said "6 delegate rows" (now corrected to 4 in the test header). The two item-text fields sit outside this slice's claimed edit surface (`automated.ref`, `revision`, `history`); the history row says so.
- Measured on head `fd634911`: the delegate's 16 cells answer exactly the matrix, unioned with nothing — `sys_business_unit`, `sys_business_unit_member` and `sys_user` read 200, every withheld verb 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`, `sys_user` create and delete 405, `sys_user_position` create 201 and read/edit/delete 200 on the delegate's own in-subtree row.

## Verification

Local gate subset on head `fd634911` (origin/main merged, including #26337): `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 55 families; all 55 ran and exited 0, and `--ran` reconciles `55 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 55 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. Repository-wide scans (`pnpm lint`, the full dogfood battery) are CI's.

`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`: `check-platform-checklist: OK — 16 areas, 329 items (324 active, 1 planned)`.

Changeset: none. `@objectstack/dogfood` is private and `docs/qa/**` ships in no package, so this PR carries `skip-changeset`.
